Privacy

How your details are handled

Last updated 16 August 2026

Who is responsible

This site is run by Mateja Vasojevikj (vasosofuji), a freelance photographer based in Skopje, North Macedonia. For anything on this page, write to vasosofuji@gmail.com.

What is collected

Only what you type into the booking form:

  • Your name, if you choose to give it, since the field is optional.
  • Your email address.
  • The date you selected, the kind of shoot, and anything you write in the message fields.

There are no analytics, no advertising trackers and no third-party cookies on this site. Nothing is stored in a database.

Why, and on what basis

Your details are used to reply to your enquiry and arrange a shoot. The lawful basis is your request, meaning steps taken at your request before entering into a contract.

Separately, the form has a checkbox asking whether I may contact you if you start a booking but do not finish it. If you tick it and then leave without submitting, the details you had entered are sent to me so I can follow up. That is optional, it is off unless you tick it, and the lawful basis is your consent. If you do not tick it, nothing is sent when you leave.

Where it goes

Submitted enquiries reach me through two services, and nowhere else:

  • Formspree delivers the form to my email inbox.
  • Telegram sends me a notification so I see the enquiry quickly.

Both are processors acting on my instructions. Your details are never sold, and are not shared with anyone else.

How long it is kept

Enquiries stay in my email and Telegram history for as long as needed to deal with the booking and any follow-up work, and are deleted on request at any time.

Your rights

You can ask for a copy of what I hold about you, ask for it to be corrected or deleted, withdraw your consent, or object to how it is used. Email vasosofuji@gmail.com and I will action it. Withdrawing consent does not affect anything done before you withdrew it.

If you are unhappy with how your details were handled, you can complain to the Agency for Personal Data Protection of North Macedonia, or to your local supervisory authority if you are in the EU or UK.
